newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National rebounds in firm bank sector.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National rebounds in firm bank sector.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc spiked higher on Wednesday, as buyers returned to the stock after recent weakness and bid talk continued to wash around the bank sector, dealers said.
Abbey shares were up 21p at 823 by 1011 GMT, rebounding after a recent 19 percent decline from its record 973p set on May 16.
"There was selling in the market which has dried up and now we have about five buyers out there," said one market-maker.
Abbey shares rose sharply earlier this year amid talk of consolidation in the bank sector, with National Westminster Bank Plc said to have made an unsuccessful takeover approach.
Yet the whiff of bids in the sector has failed to dissipate and the sector continues to be a focus of speculative interest.
"People feel there is going to be corporate activity in the sector," said one dealer.
Among other bank stocks, Lloyds TSB Plc was up 12p at 640, Barclays Plc rose 19p to 11.89-1/2, Bank of Scotland Plc gained 5-1/2p to 390-1/2.
The one casualty was Royal Bank of Scotland Plc, down 17p at 581, after HSBC Holdings Plc rebutted a press report earlier this week and said it had no plans to buy the bank.
HSBC was up 14-1/2p at 18.76-1/2 stg on the back of a sharp rise in shares in Hong Kong.
